name: Base / seven-sword style
limitations: No cloak, full beast body or Samehada; enhanced strike is descriptive. Gyuki cooperation does not grant unlimited chakra or automatic immunity to all illusions.

name: Version One chakra cloak
limitations: Controlled cloak with finite chakra; descriptive cloak strike. No full Eight-Tails ball, Version Two skeleton/body or Samehada equipment.

name: Version Two chakra cloak
limitations: Dense controlled cloak remains a chakra-drain target; rush is descriptive. No full-beast range or free external refills; Kisame's absorption is a relevant matchup limit.

name: Partial Gyuki / tentacle loadout
limitations: Partial appendages are not the full beast body or its unrestricted ball output. Descriptive strike and finite substitutions; no Naruto chakra supply or independently fighting Gyuki teammate.

name: Base / cooperating Samehada
limitations: Borrowed sword must cooperate and contact applicable chakra. No Kisame-style fusion, stolen opponent techniques, cloak/full-beast body or infinite reserves. Actions are descriptive.

name: Complete Eight-Tails transformation
limitations: Gyuki is the transformed body/partner, not a separate team slot. Finite chakra, tentacle loss and applicable absorption matter; no Naruto refills or simultaneous seven-sword humanoid stance. Tentacle strike is descriptive.
